in_sanskrit.name: अनिरूध
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: अनिर्विञ्जन (anirvijnanam) - One who is without obstacles or difficulties.

in_hindi.name: अनिरूध
in_hindi.long_meaning: अनिर्विञ्जन (anirvijnan) - वस्तुओं से अन्यथा अपेक्षित समस्याओं से मुक्त (vastuon se anyatha apeksit samasyan se mukta) - One who is free from all obstacles or difficulties.

in_tamil.name: அனிருத
in_tamil.long_meaning: அனிர்விञ்ஜனம் (anirvijnanam) - உறவுகளில் அன்புக்களில் அல்லது உபசரிதலில் அவர் அவர்களை வழிக்கும் அவர்களில் அவர்கள் அல்ல (anirvijnanam) - One who removes obstacles for others.

in_telugu.name: అనిరూధ
in_telugu.long_meaning: అనిర్జ్జద్దదేశ్య (anirjaddesya) - ఆద్యేయేదుయేదులేదుయేదుయేదులేదు (api dheyedulu deyedulu deyedulu deyedulu deyedulu) - One who removes all difficulties or obstacles.

in_marathi.name: Anirudha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Aniruddha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anirudha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Aniruddha is the name of a significant character from the Mahabharata epic. He is the grandson of Krishna and is known for his courage, wisdom, and devotion to Krishna.

in_bengali.name: Anirudha
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of Aniruddha
in_bengali.long_meaning: Anirudha একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Aniruddha is the name of a significant character from the Mahabharata epic. He is the grandson of Krishna and is known for his courage, wisdom, and devotion to Krishna.
